ecosystem_reuse.library: Existing selected Tokio 1.53.3 plus tokio-util 0.7.20 CancellationToken/DropGuard
ecosystem_reuse.manifest_change: Enabled the signal feature explicitly on util Tokio. Required dependency packages were already in Cargo.lock; no new package or lock edge was needed and no Cargo execution/resolution is credited.
ecosystem_reuse.native_lifetime_policy: Tokio owns process-wide signal dispositions. Dropping a listener does not promise restoration of the previous OS disposition. Agones cleanup cancels contexts, drops owned stream values and joins tasks; Go signal-runtime restoration/lease mechanics are superseded.
ecosystem_reuse.other_targets: NativeSignals::open returns an explicit unsupported-target error outside Unix/Windows. No unsupported platform is marked accepted.

operations.agones_requirement: Subscribe to interrupt/termination events. Unix uses SIGINT/SIGTERM; Windows uses native console interrupt, break, close, logoff and shutdown streams. Each utility owns its own stream values.
Return a cancellation context plus explicit stop handle. The signal, stop handle, closing resource phase or task destruction cancels the context. Repeated stop is idempotent.
Invoke the provided callback at most once after an interrupt/termination event. Suppress callback when cancellation wins. The parent owns callback execution and observes native task failure.

Close subscriptions during utility shutdown and join their owned tasks. Roll back rejected task ownership by dropping streams; cancellation guards cover rejected, unpolled, aborted and unwinding tasks.

production_composition.cleanup_order: Explicit shutdown and emergency Drop cancel native signal subscriptions before legacy logger cleanup; the normal shutdown path then cancels and joins owned tasks.
production_composition.resource_owner: UtilityRuntimeOwner owns the native signal cancellation phase. UtilityTaskScope owns cancellation-context/callback tasks; contexts hold only its weak handle.
production_composition.state_ownership: One native cancellation tree per source_signal_state; no signal subscriber hub, custom provider registry or second application manager.

remaining: Reconcile full application entrypoint/graceful shutdown consumers and post-gate signal assertions before acceptance. Native source utilities/resource cleanup are authored; no whole-application shutdown credit.
Existing controller queue consumers still require adoption of the native queue core.
The runtime still constructs legacy klog/error-handler/crash and HTTP/gateway profile resources; remove them after their native consumer replacement.
Filesystem watching, discovery/serialization, HTTP/TLS, admission, CRD readiness, configuration and whole-body reconciliation remain in the canonical M0003 gap list.
All target compilation, runtime signal delivery, cancellation/callback assertions and formal evidence remain NOT_STARTED behind the global BOTH-route gate.

retirement.go_only_status: GO_ONLY_SUPERSEDED; do not reactivate these as native completion gaps
superseded_production_mechanisms: manual Unix sigaction installation/restoration and async signal callback
custom nonblocking pipe, fd/errno ownership and quiescence counters
Hub subscriber map, subscription identities, mpsc delivery and shared Session reader
